subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository authorize these 14 external GitHub Action revisions, including the app-token and Codex-action updates that run with secrets, after reviewing their upstream changes and representative workflow results?
rationale: The patch is a dependency update at credential-bearing CI boundaries; automated checks cannot make the repository's third-party action trust decision.

options.title: Review and authorize revisions
options.body: Verify the upstream revisions and record redacted representative workflow results on the rebased head before allowing this PR to merge.

options.title: Defer selected action updates
options.body: Split or defer any revision whose upstream behavior cannot be approved for secret-bearing workflows now.

recommendation.title: Review and authorize revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream revisions and record redacted representative workflow results on the rebased head before allowing this PR to merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline shows the only direct recent human review signal on this PR; workflow-file ownership could not be established more specifically from the supplied material.
